skill.name: zhuangxiu-shigong-shouce
skill.description: 装修施工手册专用 Skill。覆盖拆改交底、水电施工、瓦工贴砖、木工吊顶、油漆墙面、防水闭水、隐蔽工程、工序工期、验收监工等全流程施工避坑，整合西安装修课堂装修知识库精华，帮用户看懂工地、盯住关键节点，施工不返工。
skill.summary: Use a Chinese-language renovation handbook to plan construction stages, prepare inspection checklists, and discuss common defects with contractors.
skill.author: zx029w

security_audit.summary: All 182 obfuscation alerts are false positives: the cited content is readable Chinese Markdown, including three unusually long renovation paragraphs. No evidence found of encoded executable payloads, credential collection, or audit-directed prompt injection in the reviewed material. A separate safety finding concerns reference advice that dismisses national electrical and plumbing acceptance standards.

remediation.issue: Reference advice presents homeowner preferences as a substitute for electrical and plumbing acceptance standards.
remediation.suggestion: Revise references/ref-016.md to require applicable safety standards and qualified inspections, and add this requirement to SKILL.md before generating construction advice.

content.user_title: Plan Renovation Stages and Inspection Checklists
content.value_statement: Renovation work involves sequencing decisions, hidden defects, and unclear contractor responsibilities. This Chinese-language handbook organizes construction references into practical planning advice and inspection checklists.
actual_capabilities: Locate relevant guidance through a topic index covering 180 renovation reference articles.
Explain construction sequences across demolition, electrical work, plumbing, tiling, ceilings, painting, and installation.
Prepare inspection checklists for concealed work, waterproofing tests, material checks, and visible finish defects.
Outline appliance placement and contractor coordination questions before electrical and plumbing work.
Compare tiling, ceiling, and wall finishing options using the supplied articles.
Identify commonly omitted quotation items and questions about additional charges or contractor responsibilities.
limitations: The skill provides text guidance and cannot inspect a site, test installations, or certify compliance.
References emphasize Chinese residential renovation, especially Xi'an practices; prices and requirements may differ elsewhere.
Some references conflict or dismiss formal standards; qualified professionals must verify safety advice against applicable requirements.
Several articles describe images or diagrams that are not included in the Markdown reference files.

use_cases.title: Prepare for a First Renovation
use_cases.description: Organize appliance requirements, construction stages, and contractor questions before work begins.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Trade Handoffs
use_cases.description: Prepare discussion checklists for plumbing, electrical work, tiling, ceilings, and finishing dependencies.

use_cases.title: Review Finish Options with Clients
use_cases.description: Compare ceiling and wall treatments while identifying installation constraints and questions requiring contractor confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Understand the Main Stages
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the main renovation stages for my [home type] in [location]. List the decisions I should discuss with contractors before work starts.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Concealed Work Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a homeowner discussion checklist before electrical and plumbing work is concealed in my [room]. Include records to request and tests requiring qualified professionals.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare for an inspection milestone.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Quotation Omissions
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these renovation quotation items: [items]. Identify unclear scope, possible additional charges, and questions about responsibility using the supplied references. Do not invent local prices.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: clarify contractor scope and costs.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Renovation Schedule
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a stage plan for [layout], [budget], and [target date], considering [appliances and finishes]. Cite relevant references and identify trade dependencies, inspection milestones, and conflicts. Distinguish reference opinions from requirements that qualified professionals must verify locally.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate multiple trades and review uncertain guidance.

output_examples.input: What should I discuss before the bathroom plumbing and electrical work is concealed?
output: Confirm fixture, appliance, outlet, and switch locations against the agreed layout.
Ask qualified installers to document required electrical checks and plumbing pressure tests.
Photograph routes and retain test records before concealment.
Confirm waterproofing inspection responsibilities and access to the apartment below before testing.
Resolve defects before concealment and verify acceptance criteria against applicable local requirements.

output_examples.input: What dependencies should I discuss before scheduling tiles, ceilings, and painting?
output: Complete and inspect concealed work before covering it.
Coordinate waterproofing and tiling with the selected materials and required curing periods.
Confirm how ceiling work will affect installed flooring and arrange surface protection.
Allow wall preparation layers to dry before subsequent coats.
Confirm appliance, cabinet, and door dimensions before final installation dates.

best_practices: Provide location, building type, project stage, budget, and planned appliances before requesting advice.
Request reference citations and ask the assistant to identify conflicting recommendations or missing information.
Have qualified professionals verify safety requirements and retain photographs, inspection records, and written scope agreements.
anti_patterns: Treating regional opinions or historical prices as current regulations or guaranteed quotations.
Using generated checklists to replace qualified structural, electrical, plumbing, or waterproofing inspections.
Starting demolition or concealing work without required approvals, inspections, and defect resolution.

faq.question: What does this skill contain?
faq.answer: It contains a Chinese-language renovation workflow and 180 reference articles covering construction stages, materials, costs, and inspections.

faq.question: Which assistants are listed as supported?
faq.answer: The listing supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it certify that my renovation is safe?
faq.answer: No. It provides reference guidance, not site inspections, engineering approval, or compliance certification.

faq.question: Does the guidance apply outside China?
faq.answer: Some planning principles may help, but materials, prices, regulations, and construction practices require local verification.

faq.question: Does it execute scripts or require API credentials?
faq.answer: The supplied skill consists of Markdown instructions and reference documents. It does not specify executable scripts or API credentials.

faq.question: How should conflicting advice be handled?
faq.answer: Request the relevant references and compare their assumptions. Follow applicable safety requirements and qualified professional advice instead of unsupported blanket claims.
